mapper.sql: a.achievement_id AS "achievementId", a.management_no AS "managementNo", a.teacher_user_id AS "teacherUserId", a.organization_code AS "organizationCode", a.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", a.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", a.achievement_date AS "achievementDate", a.achievement_name AS "achievementName", a.achievement_status AS "achievementStatus", a.attachment_ids::text AS "attachmentIds", a.created_at AS "createdAt", a.updated_at AS "updatedAt", (SELECT k.name FROM users u JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots k ON k.employee_no = u.employee_no WHERE u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id) AS "teacherName"

AND ( #{admin} = TRUE OR (#{self} = TRUE AND a.teacher_user_id = #{userId}) OR (#{department} = TRUE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.organization_code = a.organization_code AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' )) OR (#{certification} = TRUE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_organization_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' AND m.data_scope IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'COLLEGE', 'BUSINESS', 'ALL') AND m.organization_code = a.organization_code )) )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM education_achievements a
ORDER BY a.achievement_date DESC, a.achievement_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM education_achievements a
SELECT FROM education_achievements a WHERE a.achievement_type = 'employment-rate-achievements' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' AND a.achievement_id = #{achievementId}

SELECT FROM education_achievements a WHERE a.achievement_type = 'employment-rate-achievements' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' AND a.achievement_id = #{achievementId}
FOR UPDATE OF a
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, achievement_name = #{achievementName}, attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachmentJson} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId}, request_id = #{requestId} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement_type = 'employment-rate-achievements' AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, opinion, processed_by, request_id ) VALUES ('employment-rate-achievements', #{achievementId}, NULL, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', '취업률 실적 최초 입력', #{userId}, #{requestId})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' ORDER BY m.organization_code
mapper.sql: FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings s JOIN evaluation_management_items m ON m.management_item_code = s.management_item_code JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id AND e.element_code = s.element_code AND e.evaluation_year = s.evaluation_year JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id AND i.item_code = s.item_code JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id AND a.rule_version_id = s.rule_version_id AND a.area_code = s.area_code WHERE s.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND s.evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear} AND s.target_scope = #{organizationCode} AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND m.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND s.evaluation_confirmed_yn = 'N' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN s.effective_start_date AND s.effective_end_date
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.management_item_id)
AND s.management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}

SELECT s.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", s.management_item_name AS "managementItemName"
GROUP BY s.management_item_code, s.management_item_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.management_item_id) = 1 ORDER BY s.management_item_code

SELECT j.batch_job_id AS "jobId", j.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", j.action_type AS "actionType", j.job_status AS "jobStatus", j.total_count AS "totalCount", j.processed_count AS "processedCount", j.unprocessed_count AS "unprocessedCount", j.requester_user_id AS "requesterUserId" FROM employment_rate_batch_jobs j WHERE j.batch_job_id = #{jobId} AND (#{admin} = TRUE OR j.requester_user_id = #{userId})

SELECT i.batch_job_item_id AS "itemId", i.target_user_id AS "targetUserId", i.achievement_id AS "achievementId", i.processed_yn AS "processedYn", i.unprocessed_reason AS "unprocessedReason" FROM employment_rate_batch_job_items i WHERE i.batch_job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY i.batch_job_item_id

SELECT t.template_id AS "templateId", t.template_version AS "templateVersion" FROM excel_upload_templates t WHERE t.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND t.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY t.effective_date DESC, t.template_version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.required_column FROM excel_upload_template_rules r WHERE r.template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY r.column_order
SELECT u.user_id AS "teacherUserId", u.employee_no AS "employeeNo" FROM users u WHERE u.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.system_use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_organization_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' AND m.data_scope IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'COLLEGE', 'BUSINESS', 'ALL') AND m.organization_code = #{organizationCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO excel_upload_files ( upload_id, business_type, template_id, file_token, original_file_name, validation_status, uploader_user_id ) VALUES (#{uploadId}, 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT', #{templateId}, #{fileToken}, #{originalFileName}, #{validationStatus}, #{userId})

INSERT INTO excel_upload_staging_rows (staging_row_id, upload_id, row_number, row_payload, validation_status) VALUES (#{stagingId}, #{uploadId}, #{rowNumber}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{validationStatus})

INSERT INTO excel_upload_errors ( error_id, upload_id, row_number, column_name, input_value, error_code, error_reason, correction_guide ) VALUES (#{errorId}, #{uploadId}, #{rowNumber}, 'row', #{inputValue}, 'INVALID_ROW', #{errorReason}, '행 입력값과 중복 및 권한 범위를 확인하세요.')

INSERT INTO excel_upload_histories (upload_id, total_count, success_count, error_count, saved_count, processor_user_id) VALUES (#{uploadId}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{errorCount}, 0, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT f.upload_id AS "uploadId", f.file_token AS "fileToken", f.validation_status AS "validationStatus" FROM excel_upload_files f WHERE f.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND f.uploader_user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT f.upload_id AS "uploadId", f.validation_status AS "validationStatus" FROM excel_upload_files f WHERE f.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND f.uploader_user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.row_number AS "rowNumber", s.row_payload::text AS "payload" FROM excel_upload_staging_rows s WHERE s.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND s.validation_status = 'NORMAL' ORDER BY s.row_number

SELECT e.row_number AS "rowNumber", e.column_name AS "columnName", e.error_reason AS "errorReason" FROM excel_upload_errors e WHERE e.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY e.row_number, e.column_name

SELECT f.upload_id AS "uploadId", f.original_file_name AS "originalFileName", f.validation_status AS "validationStatus", h.total_count AS "totalCount", h.success_count AS "successCount", h.error_count AS "errorCount", h.saved_count AS "savedCount" FROM excel_upload_files f JOIN excel_upload_histories h ON h.upload_id = f.upload_id WHERE f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND f.uploader_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.uploaded_at DESC, f.upload_id
SELECT s.row_payload ->> 'errorFileId' FROM excel_upload_staging_rows s WHERE s.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND jsonb_exists(s.row_payload, 'errorFileId') ORDER BY s.row_number LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE excel_upload_files SET validation_status = 'COMMITTED' WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'VALIDATED'
